idea-plugin.name: Config Doctor
idea-plugin.description:
Config Doctor warns about suspicious Spring Boot YAML property paths before the application starts.

It inspects `application*.yml` and `application*.yaml` files, extracts YAML property paths through IntelliJ PSI, and highlights cases where a key or section looks like it was accidentally nested one level too deep.

Typical example: `spring.datasource.datasource.url` is flagged when the project already contains `spring.datasource.url`, because the YAML is valid but the effective property path is wrong.

The inspection reports a warning with the actual path, the related property it matches, and why the structure looks suspicious. It offers a quick fix only when collapsing the redundant nesting is safe and unambiguous.

This is a focused static-analysis tool for Spring Boot configuration mistakes, not a generic YAML linter or AI-based fixer.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial version with YAML PSI path extraction, suspicious property detection, warning inspection, and safe quick fixes for duplicated or shifted configuration segments.
